hook.name: CreatorFeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad fee hook that takes a fixed percentage of each swap's output (TOTAL_FEE_BPS), splitting it 70/30 between the token creator and the protocol treasury via a shared fee engine. Pools must be WETH pairs and can only be created by the authorized factory. Also supports multi-token LP rewards via a juice mechanism using V4-style fee-growth accounting.
